answer: To forge a duplicate, an attacker must acquire and register a second jetty plus matching stake, making N sybils cost N times the bond and hardware. Participants must stake a yarrow-keyed bond tied to a verified hardware jetty before voting, so each identity maps to one physical anchor. Peers sample attestations and slash double-registrations, so cheap identity farming collapses. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
